# graphiant_app_lists (Data Source)

Lists all Graphiant global app lists. Member apps aren't included — use graphiant_app_list for a specific list's members.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_app_lists" "all" {}

output "app_list_names" {
  value = [for al in data.graphiant_app_lists.all.app_lists : al.name]
}
```
